The changes introduce standard build instructions for creating a shared library (`libtree-sitter-fish.so`) and installing it into the system library directory with appropriate symbolic links.

There are no network operations, no use of dangerous functions like `eval`, no obfuscation, and no unexpected system modifications. The code aligns with normal AUR packaging practices for building and installing a tree-sitter language parser as a shared library.
